What's the point of Chapter 4.5 now? The only recent directive we've heard is go to the beach. Akira is no longer sad, Maya is no longer being a problem. He's probably going to be confronted by Niki in 0.50 which will likely involve Ami's events (and Noriko with what I've been calling.)
Have the previous instructions been rescinded just because Pareidolia's left Akira? All of the gods wanted him to rape someone in chapter 3 but he never did. They tried making him rape Karin but he never managed to do it. Is he going to carry it out by the end of chapter 4?
Spoiler
Could it be anyone but Otoha? I don't think it's possible for him to rape anyone but Otoha, Osako, and Nao at this point but Nao's godlike enough to make that impossible, and Osako can fold Akira with just her feet. Otoha's just a defenseless little girl that no one cares about with possible exception of Nodoka, and I could see Nodoka's interest in chronicling something like this since Akira hasn't outright raped someone without something muddying the perception of the act.
Osako also has her failing relationship / midwife crisis plotline she's dealing with, Nao is perpetually tied to Akira's plot, Otoha's lacking plot relevance at the moment and people don't like her right now which makes her prime bait for tragedy and sympathy points.
Things aren't looking good for Otoha, especially if I'm right about Maya Prime coming back at the end of Chapter 4. This could be an act strong enough for them to bring her back.

Moonflare's Quiz: "Who Said This?" #03

Time for the third round! Rules are the same as always: There are ten events, and you have to guess who said the following quotes, which could be from any character (excluding Akira).

To help guessing, most of them have more than one quote from each event (though one might be from the start and another from the end of the event). Guess who said it, check the answer, move to the next one (while keeping track of your overall score).
Who said this?

01: "The second thing is that I just wanted to make sure you picked up your Secret Santa present since the Christmas party is tomorrow and you always wait until the last minute" [...] "Kirin. If you need a recommendation, I'd say just get her a muzzle. She'd both enjoy it and it would benefit virtually everyone" [...] "Congratulations, Miss Imai. I hope the two of you have a great time."
Ami in "Aunt Niki (A Hundred Christmases)".

02: "This is the one time I choose to give you the opening to say something dirty and you offer me a book?" [...] "Well, you're very welcome. But yes, I am afraid of all sorts of new things. Not because I'm worried about how it will feel or anything. But more because I'm worried of what you'll think of me after."
Futaba in "A Tree Falls in the Forest".

03: "Get your fucking hands off of me you infertile, small-dicked piece of shit!" [...] "Why would that even matter?! You always said you'd rather rot in the street than come back here!"
Chika in "Dead in the Water".

04: "Where did all these tears come from?" [...] "So much for her not being around today... I knew she liked you, but... doesn't this seem a little excessive?"
Haruka in "Unfiltered Tap Water".

05: "But Sensei, it's too soon. We barely even know each other. I'm not ready for such a big leap yet. Don't get me wrong, I'm all about dating someone older and stronger and cooler than me, but in front of everyone else? That's just too much! [...] OH GOD HE'S ALREADY SICK OF ME! I CAME ON TOO STRONG AGAIN!"
Uta in "Uta's Last Stand".

06: "Memory problems? Is that really the best that all of you can come up with? Just once, I'd like to hear a new excuse and not the same... default answer I always get."
Maya in "A New Beginning".

07: "Shit. What am I supposed to do about this?" [...] "See, this is exactly why I've been pushing for a dedicated cafeteria for so long. This same thing happened to Shiori like, not even a month ago."
Himawari in "Scientific Research".

08: "Oh, yay! More roleplay." [...] "Me and my own personal army of assassins, trained in a form of ninjutsu so ancient and forgotten that they're the only clan left in existence who knows it." [...] "What do you think you're insinuating?! Do I look like the type to do something so heinous to a sleeping person?!"
Touka in "To Lift this Aching Head".

09: "I don't like the dark... it creeps me out." [...] "I don't want to die with you! I don't even like you that much!" [...] "No it won't! Just because you got lucky with guessing one thing doesn't mean another is going to happen when - KYAH! WE REALLY ARE UNDER ATTACK!"
Otoha in "Breaking Character".

10: "We're just running away together." [...] "I'm scared, Akira. I keep... hearing things. Things that... confuse the fuck out of me. And they're getting angrier and scarier and driving me up a wall and the only time I get any amount of silence anymore is when I'm with you."
Sekai in "Kyoto".


Now, for the bonus round:

This one is a bit different. I'll give you the images, and what you have to guess is which game they're talking about. I figured it should make it to the bonus since it's been talked about so much recently.



So, which game is Selebus ranting about?
Lost in You.

So, how did you do in this one? I think one of the cool things about the quiz is that it brings back scattered memories of the game, ten events at a time. If this was your first one, make sure to search for round one and two on the search bar through the "moonflare's quiz" query.

Wonder if multiple choice could be fun, but maybe that would make it too easy.

Moonflare said:
Moonflare's Quiz: "Who Said This?" #03

Time for the third round! Rules are the same as always: There are ten events, and you have to guess who said the following quotes, which could be from any character (excluding Akira).

To help guessing, most of them have more than one quote from each event (though one might be from the start and another from the end of the event). Guess who said it, check the answer, move to the next one (while keeping track of your overall score).
Who said this?

01: "The second thing is that I just wanted to make sure you picked up your Secret Santa present since the Christmas party is tomorrow and you always wait until the last minute" [...] "Kirin. If you need a recommendation, I'd say just get her a muzzle. She'd both enjoy it and it would benefit virtually everyone" [...] "Congratulations, Miss Imai. I hope the two of you have a great time."
Ami in "Aunt Niki (A Hundred Christmases)".

View attachment 4758566 View attachment 4758567 View attachment 4758570 View attachment 4758572
02: "This is the one time I choose to give you the opening to say something dirty and you offer me a book?" [...] "Well, you're very welcome. But yes, I am afraid of all sorts of new things. Not because I'm worried about how it will feel or anything. But more because I'm worried of what you'll think of me after."
Futaba in "A Tree Falls in the Forest".

View attachment 4758588 View attachment 4758590
03: "Get your fucking hands off of me you infertile, small-dicked piece of shit!" [...] "Why would that even matter?! You always said you'd rather rot in the street than come back here!"
Chika in "Dead in the Water".

View attachment 4758591 View attachment 4758592
04: "Where did all these tears come from?" [...] "So much for her not being around today... I knew she liked you, but... doesn't this seem a little excessive?"
Haruka in "Unfiltered Tap Water".

View attachment 4758593 View attachment 4758594
05: "But Sensei, it's too soon. We barely even know each other. I'm not ready for such a big leap yet. Don't get me wrong, I'm all about dating someone older and stronger and cooler than me, but in front of everyone else? That's just too much! [...] OH GOD HE'S ALREADY SICK OF ME! I CAME ON TOO STRONG AGAIN!"
Uta in "Uta's Last Stand".

View attachment 4758596 View attachment 4758597
06: "Memory problems? Is that really the best that all of you can come up with? Just once, I'd like to hear a new excuse and not the same... default answer I always get."
Maya in "A New Beginning".

View attachment 4758598 View attachment 4758599
07: "Shit. What am I supposed to do about this?" [...] "See, this is exactly why I've been pushing for a dedicated cafeteria for so long. This same thing happened to Shiori like, not even a month ago."
Himawari in "Scientific Research".

View attachment 4758601 View attachment 4758602

[...] "What do you think you're insinuating?! Do I look like the type to do something so heinous to a sleeping person?!"
Touka in "To Lift this Aching Head".

posts.content_html_raw:
I guess that'd vary depending on your feelings on the characters/story. It's hard to weigh some major plot points more than others. Maya Prime's disintegration would be most people's answer, I'd imagine. Sensei getting his name back was emotional and a big moment but it was more pivotal for Sensei's development than for the actual plot I think.

For me I think the biggest milestone was probably Ayane making it to the roof the second time. It caused a big tonal shift, the realisation that other people could be added to the squad (even if Maya couldn't accept it initially) and Ayane's curiosity and drive gave them some purpose and direction in actually trying to figure things out a bit and add more people to the squad.

All the resets before that are pretty much just Sensei and Maya bickering and going with the flow.

I think this evokes a certain discussion about the notion of LiL being in a Japanese city (it's clearly not).
Well, first of all, it is a fake Japanese city from the start, Kumon-mi isn't real. But if you look at, say, Chika: a gyaru that's actually Filipino? Although not that unlikely, the whole scene where she discusses her gyaru outlook and skin color not equating to slutiness is very western.

I'm not going over every aspect of Japanese culture that is portrayed, but, basically, it is always from the perspective of a westerner looking in. Actually, a better way of putting it is to say that it is a fake highschool with Japanese decorations (as they're perceived by westerners) sprinkled here and there.

The poetry is basically all western, and so are the pop culture references. Furthermore, if we're feeling generous we can say that most of the Japanese day-to-day way of speaking and acting is being filtered out, but in fact it just isn't there because Selebus isn't Japanese and neither is most of his target audience (so we do away with all the sans, kuns and everyone just calls eachother by their first names). And I'm not even talking about the token "Senpai" and "Kouhai" when they're rarely thrown at you to remind you that you're supposed to be in Japan (mostly by Imani of all people), but there's just no real Japanese spirit anywhere.

Again, I don't think this is an issue, because I don't think it was the purpose to try to create an actual Japanese scenario - but we have to agree it just isn't. The characters don't behave as actual Japanese people in a Japanese setting. They behave in a more general western sense with Japanese references here and there. For instance, everyone is just plain direct. This is not normal for Japanese people, it is normal for westerners. An entire cast made of highly individualistic people isn't very Japanese either. Lastly, it lacks the proper social geas that eastern countries tend to have - their so called "atmosphere".
Back to the question, I think that it's there because Selebus is American and so is most of his target audience. I think we could do without it, but he's not a perfect author.

I didn't go search for Shohei Otani when he was brought up, and was honestly kind of annoyed that it lasted so long in that scene - but I was way more annoyed at the Bojack thing, and those are the moments that an editor would certainly delete from the final product because it's just Selebus not knowing when to either shut up, or how to convey his ideas properly through actual plot and characters, and instead pausing the game to throw a freeform at us.
I'm more okay with references that explain themselves, such as quoting an author because, well, the quote is there. Mirroring an entire scene from a tv show is way less okay to me in terms of storytelling because I'd like LiL to be able to stand by itself, rather than wasting my time dissecting something that had no meaning but being a tribute (but that's a personal preference).

Things like Shohei Otani (that just aren't based on western people because "hey, gotta remind them we're in Japan") I just wave off - much like everything else I don't understand or care for (like random subway, raid shadows legends, or Selebus rants). To counter it, I was less annoyed by the Sara conversation on Nicolas Cage and that's because I know who Nicolas Cage is. So, I mean, take it for what it is - as long as it can be waved off (and I don't have to search for it on google to get it), I think I'm okay with it.

Moonflare said:
I think this evokes a certain discussion about the notion of LiL being in a Japanese city (it's clearly not).
Well, first of all, it is a fake Japanese city from the start, Kumon-mi isn't real. But if you look at, say, Chika: a gyaru that's actually Filipino? Although not that unlikely, the whole scene where she discusses her gyaru outlook and skin color not equating to slutiness is very western.

I'm not going over every aspect of Japanese culture that is portrayed, but, basically, it is always from the perspective of a westerner looking in. Actually, a better way of putting it is to say that it is a fake highschool with Japanese decorations (as they're perceived by westerners) sprinkled here and there.

The poetry is basically all western, and so are the pop culture references. Furthermore, if we're feeling generous we can say that most of the Japanese day-to-day way of speaking and acting is being filtered out, but in fact it just isn't there because Selebus isn't Japanese and neither is most of his target audience (so we do away with all the sans, kuns and everyone just calls eachother by their first names). And I'm not even talking about the token "Senpai" and "Kouhai" when they're rarely thrown at you to remind you that you're supposed to be in Japan (mostly by Imani of all people), but there's just no real Japanese spirit anywhere.

Again, I don't think this is an issue, because I don't think it was the purpose to try to create an actual Japanese scenario - but we have to agree it just isn't. The characters don't behave as actual Japanese people in a Japanese setting. They behave in a more general western sense with Japanese references here and there. For instance, everyone is just plain direct. This is not normal for Japanese people, it is normal for westerners. An entire cast made of highly individualistic people isn't very Japanese either. Lastly, it lacks the proper social geas that eastern countries tend to have - their so called "atmosphere".
Back to the question, I think that it's there because Selebus is American and so is most of his target audience. I think we could do without it, but he's not a perfect author.

I didn't go search for Shohei Otani when he was brought up, and was honestly kind of annoyed that it lasted so long in that scene - but I was way more annoyed at the Bojack thing, and those are the moments that an editor would certainly delete from the final product because it's just Selebus not knowing when to either shut up, or how to convey his ideas properly through actual plot and characters, and instead pausing the game to throw a freeform at us.
I'm more okay with references that explain themselves, such as quoting an author because, well, the quote is there. Mirroring an entire scene from a tv show is way less okay to me in terms of storytelling because I'd like LiL to be able to stand by itself, rather than wasting my time dissecting something that had no meaning but being a tribute (but that's a personal preference).

Things like Shohei Otani (that just aren't based on western people because "hey, gotta remind them we're in Japan") I just wave off - much like everything else I don't understand or care for (like random subway, raid shadows legends, or Selebus rants). To counter it, I was less annoyed by the Sara conversation on Nicolas Cage and that's because I know who Nicolas Cage is. So, I mean, take it for what it is - as long as it can be waved off (and I don't have to search for it on google to get it), I think I'm okay with it.
Click to expand...
Funnily enough, the “too American to be in Kumom-mi” moments I feel don’t come from any of the mentioned western reference, but the racial and gender stereotype awareness Sensei sometimes displays; one is how he responded to Wakana’s “No Imani” sign on her office door, the other is when Sensei said something like “way to go and perpetuate gender roles, [placeholder]” (I forgot where this comes from). For a deplorable person growing up exclusively in Japan, a place with high racial homogeneity and practices difficult-to-challenge gender roles, Sensei’s awareness is imo unusually high, high enough to have me think that “this feels like a US Selly thing and not a JP Sensei thing”.

Regardless, to me this is relatively the same as the rest of the brought up reference examples in the context of viewing experience: not really immersion breaking, not really serious, and not really affecting how I understand stories if I don’t get them.

Sure, you can say that. I'm well acknowledged on limitness of entertainment. LiL is foremost a parody of everything you'd expect from visual novel. It's not, at any point, an ancient satire like that of Don Quixote. It doesn't have connection to anything and this rootlessness is what labels modern novels. There are enough self-ambivalences in LiL.

And Twin Peaks and David Lynch oops, Selebus really likes this trick heh? Well damn it I'm going to be truthful here. Without a cast of doubt I will truly list Arms Bent Back and Second Sun as the most boring Happy Events. It's just empty and stacking of symbols, totally devoid of vigilance and amazement I get from others. I'm more than willingly to acknowledge Lynch was a master bluffer and mystifier (just take a look on how contorted his sayings were and you'll understand). With his considerable directive skill, he managed to pull the strings of people into believing that they had witnessed bizarre or supernatural happenings. Question at hand is that I just really can't appreciate American Symbolism (yeah I'm not using surrealist cause it's symbolism in every aspect), in the end there is no surface plot (complete smokescreen) but symbols that can be interpreted in anyway you'd like. I think kitsch would be my impression for them since however dreamlike the media is, it's still artificial and can't cover a cycle. Nothing short of intellectual puzzles.

Hold on, isn't it just LiL.........Still, LiL has something genuine in characters and story.

P.S. Lynch and his works are still way better than most of the entertainment we have today. At least there are something to think. No offense to Lynch and may he find eternal peace in his rest.

I'm not much into big words, so I'll try to keep it short. It's because of the perception and expectatives the game sets. In both cases you start as someone guided by their instincts. But, and I like that you mentioned Rance, both games start to deviate from the formula little by little. You see it "more quickly" in LiL because the update time is short. But (apparently due to the writer changing sometimes) you can also see that gradual shift in Rance.
Of course, since Rance is mostly a game in a wider world, it's hidden beneath the lore and the story of each game, but Rance's priorities slowly shift, though his core stays the same (though you could say he did change his priorities a little bit, after dying). That could be said to be the difference between Rance and Sensei, since while Sensei's priorites slowly shift, the goal (to me) is to change his core (a goal which the broader environment he inhabits takes a special interest in), while Rance is gradually changed by his own actions and his environment, though the latter doesn't really hold him in any special regard (shut up Planner, you were overruled, you can't kill him).
LiL can be used to jork it, I'm sure there's a few persons like the one depicted above that do, and I'm sure there's people who can't really find material or sufficient downtime to actually do it, or bother to do it. I think that, like all games, it just tells a story. And like all stories, it's up to you whether to hold it in any kind of regard, or just consume it as such stories are meant to be consumed. Callously.

I get that it's a joke, but I'm a very respectful person. I don't go snooping around people's phones, and more often than not I tend to keep to myself and not involve myself in other people's issues. The reason I bring this up is that this isn't that simple of a matter.
Speaking as a parent, when you have a child - many of your priorities change. I can take care of myself, I've been an adult for a very long time. Thus I have no reason to snoop at my friend's cellphone, because whatever's there, I can keep myself out of danger regardless of it. But this isn't a matter of curiosity.

It's a different story if my 15 year old daughter is sending masturbation videos to him. The stakes change and the variables become skewed, for the risk of my friend actually being a predator in disguise FAR outweighs the fallout from him getting mad at me for going through his messages after I saw that my daughter sent him said video. Which, in this case, would be none. Akira would never find out how many messages she went through.

To the point, Rika was wrong. Akira is a predator, and she very much needed to get Rin far away from him and him in jail. Which she would have found out and done if she did what she should have done. The issue with this entire plot is that you involve Rika and Rie talking about how Rin is sending masturbation videos to Akira, and inserting a lot of actual believable behavior from parents, and yet there's no "well, how about this dude, then?" from either Rika, or especially Rie.

They talked about it, and the messaging from Rika was more or less clear. She brought a wizard photo of Rin to guilt-trip him, she tried to seduce Akira so that he'd be satisfied with another Rokuhara, she mentioned how Rie was aware of the situation. I get what she's doing, and I guess it fits her character, I just don't like it from a story standpoint and I think it would have been better if she couldn't go through his phone.
This isn't a huge thing for me, but it's one of those things that I, as a reader, have to take at face value and just accept that Rika and Rie chose to act as big dumb dumbs this time.

Amazing Ranking, thank you for compiling this data for everyone here in this small community!

To continue off what Mike.Ross80 said, if this ranking is used from tier lists from different times in this thread's history(I know of 3 massive times this threads gone into best girl tier list ranking) taken into count, we can not only view this as a ranking of the most popular characters in F95zone, but also a possibility ranking of the most popular Lesson in Love events in F95zone.

This could explain why the confusion people had with Uta and other characters being ranked so high. I believe the selection bias in this game is very difficult to remove, as it is a ongoing game with a continuing narrative and with plenty of character events to still be played out. From what I'm seeing, people have really enjoy Rin and Yumi's events with other character thought to be unpopular rising up the ranks due to their events and how they're being written into the story being more and more enjoyable to read through, or more spine-chilling to read.

Someone else smarter than me could probably figure out that out and poke holes in what I mentioned but it's a interesting thought that might lead to the discussion of the recent quality of characters events to hold us over until D-Day.

a few corrections and observations:
1 - Ayane carries guns around (in Japan), murders janitors left and right, has no sense of privacy towards Akira, is ever a stranger to the Arakawa household even though it's all she has (having forsaken the Amamiya name in everything but what benefits her), and her obssession with being Himawari's mother and Akira's wife has a high chance of leading her to darker paths. That it didn't yet, is also what currently distances herself from Ami. But the potential is there.

If we're measuring her being adjusted with her mother leaving and her father not liking her very much, she's not that well adjusted tbh. Chika, for instance, lost her mother and had to care for a child since she was a child, both emotionally and as the one provider for the household. Ayane has all the money of the Amamiyas, her servants and no one to take responsability for (including herself). They're not even comparable in terms of how well put toghether their life is vs what they had to deal with.

2 - I agree towards Futaba, I'd just add that she is also an overweight kid that had a history of being too thin, and yet can't lose her weight anymore in an uncanny fashion. And her parents pretty much left her to her own judgement. The entire thing is basically a token example of predator bait.

3 - Kirin sexually assaults and blackmails a fellow classmate multiple times, to call this least fucked up alongside Rin and Noriko is odd, to say the least - when Kirin should be in jail.

4 - Sara is an alcoholic that often treats Sana's problems with alcohol as well. She isn't able to deal with Shota's death and also often dumps that on Sana (having to take care of her mom). Now, I love Sara and her character makes total sense to me, and I also respect her for what she's able to do. But she's certainly not the most well adjusted when you also have the likes of Maki, Imani and even Tsubasa as a side character.

5 - Osako did not give up her dreams of being a martial artist for love, she had to do it because of the city closing down. This put her into a situation where she already focused a lot of herself onto Wakana, and then had what made the center of her persona taken away - as by the time the city opens up again, she's likely to be too old to compete.
I've started making my own psych evaluations of everyone, but that will take a long time, as just Chika and Yumi already is as long as this entire post - so if it comes out, it will come out - eventually.

I had to split the question 3 ways because if you try to average all 3 you get wrong and not correctly interesting answers. I mean Otoha being the most normal / least fucked up? The person who gets into a writing session so hard she'd beat her lover and in a non canon setting, fucked the first little boy she saw? I'm resisting the urge to make up an equivalent of kiddy diddler for her.

1) Ayane is a well adjusted, not normal girl who's pretty fucked up. Tons of trauma from the parental neglect, she has access to a monthly stipend that we could probably live for a year on per payment, she has a history of killing janitors and having an absurd amount of weapons because the god above gods of this world needed comedy relief, she's never put effort into it. Outside of that, I'd challenge you to find a time where she freaked out where it wasn't justified, and the amount she freaks out never exceeds the problem.
2) Futaba is a very normal, somewhat well adjusted girl who's been very fucked up. On top of Sensei making her a sex freak turning her world upside down to the point that I'm not sure if her degradation fetish in 0.46 was always her (sana style) or a result of Sensei's treatment of her, she also has the world fucking with her brain preventing her from getting the relief of achieving weight loss despite all her efforts.
3) Kirin is a horribly adjusted, not normal girl who wasn't really fucked up by anything to become that way. When you think like that, the world becomes easy to deal with.
Ayane hurt her so she hurt her back. Since Kirin caught her having sex, Kirin used sex against her. It's as pathetic as it sounded when she spoke it out loud both times. After the first blackmailing session though she was actually trying to use the second one to bond with Ayane as evidenced by the dialogue if you say Kirin wins the BJ. Kirin is later seen researching sociopathy after Lavender's Green, there's a good chance she'd have been researching relevant articles to try deal with Ayane with the same mindset, she wants to be friends with Ayane but can't do that while being the sociopath she believes herself to be.
Kirin isn't really trying to change until she's close enough to Akira to start going on dates, and she's fighting the revelations all of the way, only really letting go once she hears Akira's true thoughts about what he's doing to her, where she drops it immediately and tries to really feel for the first time in her life. Coming off of that, on green path at least, she unloads onto Ayane and gives her a true apology...Just way too late for Ayane to care.
4) If we remember that grooming was a word before today's popular definition, and that definition is an example of the old definition (Pedophiles are grooming children into having sex with Pedophiles) then Maki groomed Makoto for the world of sex, and is currently conciously grooming Miku to sell it, while unconciously grooming Miku to have it. Tsubasa is grooming both of her children to have sex with Akira, and Imani is already expecting Akira to be having sex with his students by the absolute beginning of chapter 3 (When Maya, Ayane and Akira reset into his office, Imani comes in and assumes they're having a threesome). I don't think Wakana, Rika or Osako would have made that leap or would have been fine to make that observation, much less that soon.
Considering the competition though I'd probably rate Imani second. Giving your underage children alcohol is legal in a lot of places, including over half of the US states and is less of an evil to me. We don't see Sana having a drinking problem like Molly does the two times she does it so it's not a chronic activity. And it kind of worked. (Sara is the most well adjusted of the side characters, but there's a mile between her and Ayane. Sara's also pretty fucked up and with specific backstory insight, not normal)
5) fair. I was mostly recalling Osako's backstory using Wakana's flashback event because I didn't care enough to doublecheck for Osako. Placing her there was more an exercise of not putting people like Rika there, whose chronic idiocy would be an insult for the title unless the competition was that bad. I'd probably give the next spots to Yuki, Chinami and Imani, though those 3 have experienced a bunch of trauma but seemed to have handled it well enough.

spoilers.html:
1) Ayane is a well adjusted, not normal girl who's pretty fucked up. Tons of trauma from the parental neglect, she has access to a monthly stipend that we could probably live for a year on per payment, she has a history of killing janitors and having an absurd amount of weapons because the god above gods of this world needed comedy relief, she's never put effort into it. Outside of that, I'd challenge you to find a time where she freaked out where it wasn't justified, and the amount she freaks out never exceeds the problem.
2) Futaba is a very normal, somewhat well adjusted girl who's been very fucked up. On top of Sensei making her a sex freak turning her world upside down to the point that I'm not sure if her degradation fetish in 0.46 was always her (sana style) or a result of Sensei's treatment of her, she also has the world fucking with her brain preventing her from getting the relief of achieving weight loss despite all her efforts.
3) Kirin is a horribly adjusted, not normal girl who wasn't really fucked up by anything to become that way. When you think like that, the world becomes easy to deal with.
Ayane hurt her so she hurt her back. Since Kirin caught her having sex, Kirin used sex against her. It's as pathetic as it sounded when she spoke it out loud both times. After the first blackmailing session though she was actually trying to use the second one to bond with Ayane as evidenced by the dialogue if you say Kirin wins the BJ. Kirin is later seen researching sociopathy after Lavender's Green, there's a good chance she'd have been researching relevant articles to try deal with Ayane with the same mindset, she wants to be friends with Ayane but can't do that while being the sociopath she believes herself to be.
Kirin isn't really trying to change until she's close enough to Akira to start going on dates, and she's fighting the revelations all of the way, only really letting go once she hears Akira's true thoughts about what he's doing to her, where she drops it immediately and tries to really feel for the first time in her life. Coming off of that, on green path at least, she unloads onto Ayane and gives her a true apology...Just way too late for Ayane to care.
4) If we remember that grooming was a word before today's popular definition, and that definition is an example of the old definition (Pedophiles are grooming children into having sex with Pedophiles) then Maki groomed Makoto for the world of sex, and is currently conciously grooming Miku to sell it, while unconciously grooming Miku to have it. Tsubasa is grooming both of her children to have sex with Akira, and Imani is already expecting Akira to be having sex with his students by the absolute beginning of chapter 3 (When Maya, Ayane and Akira reset into his office, Imani comes in and assumes they're having a threesome). I don't think Wakana, Rika or Osako would have made that leap or would have been fine to make that observation, much less that soon.
Considering the competition though I'd probably rate Imani second. Giving your underage children alcohol is legal in a lot of places, including over half of the US states and is less of an evil to me. We don't see Sana having a drinking problem like Molly does the two times she does it so it's not a chronic activity. And it kind of worked. (Sara is the most well adjusted of the side characters, but there's a mile between her and Ayane. Sara's also pretty fucked up and with specific backstory insight, not normal)
5) fair. I was mostly recalling Osako's backstory using Wakana's flashback event because I didn't care enough to doublecheck for Osako. Placing her there was more an exercise of not putting people like Rika there, whose chronic idiocy would be an insult for the title unless the competition was that bad. I'd probably give the next spots to Yuki, Chinami and Imani, though those 3 have experienced a bunch of trauma but seemed to have handled it well enough.

Touka has some very real problems, she's just fully aware of them and managing them appropriately.

Her future isn't her own, she is trapped by the Tsukioka legacy, and ultimately, the husband assigned to her (inevitably the son of a high-level manager at her father's company) will be adopted formally as a Tsukioka and he'll be the one to inherit the company. She'll never be the CEO. She'll transition from CEO's Daughter to CEO's Wife and take over the Foundation, because that's the woman's role.

This is precisely why Tsubasa is nudging her to have a wild streak now, because Tsubasa didn't, and has to live with that regret, so now she's trying to experience it vicariously through her elder daughter.

This also means that it's very likely this will create some real issues with Touka's mental health in her adult life, but those won't likely manifest until after she's married.

AzureVolt said:
Amazing Ranking, thank you for compiling this data for everyone here in this small community!

To continue off what Mike.Ross80 said, if this ranking is used from tier lists from different times in this thread's history(I know of 3 massive times this threads gone into best girl tier list ranking) taken into count, we can not only view this as a ranking of the most popular characters in F95zone, but also a possibility ranking of the most popular Lesson in Love events in F95zone.

This could explain why the confusion people had with Uta and other characters being ranked so high. I believe the selection bias in this game is very difficult to remove, as it is a ongoing game with a continuing narrative and with plenty of character events to still be played out. From what I'm seeing, people have really enjoy Rin and Yumi's events with other character thought to be unpopular rising up the ranks due to their events and how they're being written into the story being more and more enjoyable to read through, or more spine-chilling to read.

Of course I'm not 100% sure of this, as I'm couldn't be sure how Touka and Sara would be ranked so high if it wasn't for the community really liking the characters, their events, and their designs(Big fan of Touka myself).

Someone else smarter than me could probably figure out that out and poke holes in what I mentioned but it's a interesting thought that might lead to the discussion of the recent quality of characters events to hold us over until D-Day.

The only thing I couldn't confirm is how old the tier list data is, it seems like it's been taken over a course of 4-5 months, starting from December 2024.
Click to expand...
You might be right, especially if most of these lists were posted around the same time ranges. Like during one of the 2 month break periods each year. Could very well see the girls who were featured in a good way bump up (and in turn some of those who looked badly, fall)

If this was chapter 1 my answer would not be her, but unironically the most normal girl right now is Yumi.
Yes, she is a poor girl with abandonment issues AND a Yakuza princess, but apart from that, she posseses the most common sense out of anyone. How many times does something absurd happen only for her to be the only one to see it for what it is and call it out? Her origins might be extremely rare but her behaviour is something you could actually expect from a normal person. From being mean, rude and straight up heartless due to her upbringing to maturing emotionally, now she's just a normal girl who's got a bit of a character and is going through hard times, but that's it.

If I had to choose second place... ofc it's Noriko (again) She is a disgusting brony that wants to fuck her teacher and all of her friends, and her sister is a super famous idol that everybody knows, but that's kinda it?
Everybody else is literally worse in olympic tier of metrics.

Before anybody says "Otoha" again, she's literally a predator worse than Akira that would immediately try to rape a cute little boy as soon as she saw him. Touka and Ayane behave the most normal, but they are secretly psychopaths capable of murdering in cold blood, and everybody else is broken beyond repair, sexually deranged, mentally insane, or all three of them together.

The better question to ask here is "who is the second most fucked up girl" because there's probably no argument against Ami being number 1.

Of course, if we will drop her in the real world, she'll be the outsider who wants her teacher (though more romantically, but she's not totally against sex with him)... Noriko though... egh, she puts some illegal stuff to Akira's meal/drink during 1st Dorm Wars. Also she carries knives with her (but we can omit this as a comedic component of her character).

Click to expand...
There's a certain degree of the game that you're going to miss out on. Most of the character events take place in text but there are a bunch of visual and audio cues during the game in random events. The first thing the game does is tell you to stop playing the game if you're not going to play with sound, and I imagine he'd do the same with visual if it wasn't already there in the name.

If you're going to attempt it anyway I'd highly recommend autovn for you then, it skips most of the grind and a lot of the puzzles, and you can find the puzzle guide for most of the others.

That said, with the sheer size of the game no one is going to reprocess the entire game to try and shrink it. The game pulls a lot of tricks and you've already said people would have to manually edit it. In the last update alone there's scenes where they remove text that could have appeared as narration dialogue, and instead put it up on the screen, including the variable increases for this specific character's affection and some flag changes which won't matter for people who aren't nerds for this game. You'd need people to put it back to text, and I don't see anyone who doesn't want to make it their entire project doing it.

Starting to sound like it's not worth it for you.

I've played ripples, ravager, once in a lifetime, sisterly lust, light of my life and a few others.
some of them were perfect in regards to me not missing anything, since not a lot was purely visual, and also the parts that were? you could understand what's happening from the text alone after
Click to expand...
As others have said. This game uses visual storytelling that may not transform to an only text medium. Sometimes there are unnerving contrast between narration in the text box and the actual scene before your eyes. Some people around here who are both smart and observant can understand some of it. Some people can just get the feeling "there is something wrong here."

Hell, one of the first events in the game was:
Visual: You see a room covered with armless clocks.
Text: A narration about how worms are making a home inside your body.
Sound: A joyful children song about learning alphabet, with every letter has a word with it. ex :A! Apple! B! Banana. etc

What i meant to say was, this is a diffucult game to understand . You need to read the text carefully, translate the hex code and ceaser cyper, listen the music and try to understand if it has any connection to what is happening, think about why there is a repeating theme of whales, spiders, moons in the background scene.

Trying to put these things into text wouldn't work.

Recommendation: Corporate Culture. This game can be played by built-in text to voice feature. While it gets updated once a year, i have nothing but good things to say about it.

posts.content_html_raw:
Hungnoxu said:
I just started today. Do I actually need to raise affection points for every girls or focus on the girls I like?
Click to expand...
There are a couple of times where raising the stats of girls you like gives you a little extra, but the game is designed to have a way of you seeing every event / scene in the game. General consensus is viewing every event (green path) is the intended way of experiencing the game.
Sometimes you might even want to consider not viewing an event for a while to grind up stats. When you've viewed every character event available the game will proceed with main events that will progress the chapter. If you need to do some grinding that's how you give yourself the space.
Grinding tip: If you have spare days probably in chapter 2 that you're just trying to mill through to the night or something, grind for Osako, Chinami and Tsubasa affection in that order, at least to 30. You can reach points where you need 20 extra affection for them before you can see their next event, and you can only earn 2 per week due to the probably afternoon timeslot needed for them.

Highly recommend the guide mod, AutoVN is there if affection grinding would put you off of the game otherwise, but you will forget that side content exists.

You should know about URM and how it can be used to skip / fix atrocious problems in the game, but never use it to make dialogue choices / view alternate dialogue paths without rolling back before the split and letting it play out naturally. You can break your saves and make diagnosis impossible since checks for missed events are randomly placed inside unrelated events.
You should also block "bonus" from being monitored as a variable unless you want to read twice as much text and click several hundred times, it governs the old SFW mode LiL had for a while. You'll miss out on some random lore but you could always ask about it here.

Two very technical explanations:
1) Sensei's actual words are "...come to think of it, you [Ayane] are rarely even around when that happens, are you?". It's not really never if one wants to be a Mr. Literal and if one wants to count Stop Looking For Answers as Ayane actually being around Sensei's past blackouts at least once (though it was by the very end of it and Ayane at the time didn't know what was happening). Still, I would also assume that "rarely even" is enough the same as "never" to avoid playing around words too much.
2) TH15 15NT M3 is v0.38 and Operation: Sleepytime is v0.42, so "technically" by the time of the latter event, Ayane has been made aware of Sensei's strange condition, and can identify it when Sensei was experiencing shit.

Back to some theorycrafting.
Something that went on in my mind for some time now.

So who murdered Ami pre "Times New Roman"?
Knifes: Two people come to mind. Tsuneyo and Noriko. But i guess Tsuneyo can be left out, leaving Noriko, who might have wanted revenge for the cucking in the wardrobe or what ever it was.
Maya: Got cucked in that event, so she had a motive too (stronger compared to Noriko in that event).

Knifes again: It's interesting that Ami (the dead one) also had a knife in her mouth.
This kinda looks cliche "Snitches get stitches" , or "Horsehead in your bed" style.

Maya and Ami herself, have the strongest motiv IMO.

Still there's how Himawari is there with Ami clones?, and how Ami is still alive and kicking next to Akira, unrecognized.

So i wonder.
Unless Maya really killed Ami for the cucking (maybe knowing it was just a copy), maybe Ami just killed a disposable copy of herself?
Maybe that copy was about to spill the beans, hence the knife in the mouth? Or was it a sacrifice in the long term?

This leads me further, if Ami can swap place or mind with alterations of herself and if alterations always have to look like her.
Like, in a different reality Ami is for example Chika?

Knifes: Two people come to mind. Tsuneyo and Noriko. But i guess Tsuneyo can be left out, leaving Noriko, who might have wanted revenge for the cucking in the wardrobe or what ever it was.

Like, in a different reality Ami is for example Chika?

There is a walkthrough mod on the first page which is an in-game tool that displays every event available at a single time, and the hints/requirements to them. No one should play without it tbh. Always make sure to take a look at the hints tab before engaging the following event.

The AutoVN isn't optimal as it is a tool for those that simply can't stand the nature of the game. The thing is, the game is meant for you to play it, and even though the AutoVN may try its best, things will always be lost by forcing LiL to be a VN. It really should be a last resort for people that just can't stand LiL and wouldn't play it otherwise.

Lastly, there is a puzzle guide, also on the first page. On every chapter of the game there will be at least two puzzles during special events. These are not covered by the walkthrough mod, and you should consult the spreadsheet (puzzle guide) when it happens.

For anything else, you can consult us. If asking about a specific event, inform its name, or at the very least what's happening/who's saying what, so that we can identify it and troubleshoot.

There is also a useful tool called URM, that I recommend you install. It isn't needed, but it will inform you of variations during the events, and enable you to change some variables instead of grinding later on.

Because it amuse me, here's an event that happened just 20 minutes ago. Nothing relevant, just a little text for passing time.
Today, as I was casually walking towards my home, passing at the edge of a playground, two children, aged 8 or 9, started shouting «Hello, sir!» and «Sir, hello!». Ignoring them vehemently, I continued on my way. But they continued their squawking, and as soon as I passed, their refrain changed to «Bye, sir!» and «Sir, bye!». Still ignoring them, and vigorously picking up my pace, one of them fatally yelled, "Can you hear me, sir!?". Turning slowly, and wearing my usual expression, mixing contempt and indifference (a clever blend I've mastered to perfection), I faced them.

They waved their hands joyfully, all smiles.

Raising mine and waving it briefly in turn, I finally answered them. "Bye," I replied, before turning around and continuing on my way.

Never I'll understand children. Never.

Later on, you can have this events changed up to reflect the corruption growth the characters have gone through.

Cckerberos has already done a wonderful hint mod on what to do to progress the game and what events will lock out content so honestly there's no need for improvement on that aspect.

Sorry for the rumble everyone.

Moonflare's Quiz: "Who Said This?" #04

Time for the fourth round! This time it's a thematic one, with all the events coming from DORM WARS! Rules are the same as always: There are ten events, and you have to guess who said the following quotes, which could be from any character (excluding Akira).

To help guessing, most of them have more than one quote from each event (though one might be from the start and another from the end of the event). Guess who said it, check the answer, move to the next one (while keeping track of your overall score).
(mind that the same answer could happen more than once)

Who said this?

01: "Have any last words before your team is completely and utterly annihilated, Uta?" [...] "Yumi will absolutely participate because, if she doesn't, I have a complete log of her absences that I will be forwarding to the principal".
Makoto in "Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars!"

02: "Tell Ami to step down before she gets any further into her backstory or I'll basically lose before I even have a chance." [...] "Did you seriously get hard for your little sister? Pervert..."
Noriko in "Imouto Mode!"

03: "The idea of "fun" does not exist. All we have is silence....shadows...the dark...and a mission. A mission to remain unseen. Unheard. Unnoticed." [...] "Gone...like the color of the Chitose River in winter...waiting for its moment to return. But when? And who will be there to watch as the color returns?"
Uta in "Dorm War II: Pre-Game Show".

04: "Sorry, we're fresh out of 'You are extremely attractive and I was not prepared for that' on account of you being on a date." [...] "Not everything has an answer, you know! And not everything has to! So it's probably best to just never ask questions at all and accept everything you're given! And if it sounds like I'm saying that reluctantly, I'm not! Please! Just do what you're told!"
Himawari in "Hiding in Plain Sight".

05: "Yes. I... I need help with English." [...] "Is she still looking over here? Should both of our tops magically fall off at the same time?" [...] "We have a problem. I can't remember which order I said things in. Do I take my top off or not?"
Rin in "Sexy Swimsuit Showdown".

06: "The only difference now is you've somehow convinced everyone else you're nice." [...] "Do not talk about her to me or I actually will kill you." [...] "I have nothing to feel guilty about. I'm not the one who made him into what he is today."
Maya in "Flowerchild".

07: "Touka, even though you've accidentally touched a horse wiener at least once, I've always loved you and am ready to spend the rest of my life with you." [...] "Touka, hurry the heck up! I ain't allowed to take my vitamins until you say your vows! Which, if ya think about it, doesn't make any sense for a friggin' 1v1 obstacle course!"
Miku in "Sea of Balls (Wise Turtle)".

08: "Hey, you don't have to be all shy and stuff! I think it'd be totally great if you lived here. I'm not trying to gate-keep it or anything. The more, the merrier." [...] "Plus, if you were looking at apartments, it would totally explain why you left the Dorm Wars early yesterday and forced us into an 8 v 10 match-up where we also lost a point due to your absence."
Chika in "Happy".

09: "Spiderwebs. A calendar. The ones you keep inside. A god. A bucket. Heresy. A man who almost died. A ghost. A moon. She's lying. There's nowhere we can hide. We're done. We're doomed. We're dying. The well has nearly dried."
Yasu in "Priestess of Fallen Snow".

10: "I don't want your fucking money." [...] "Christmas date!" [...] "If you're going to reject me again, at least do it properly. Don't just stand there like an idiot. Say something."
Niki in "Tip Your Bartender".


Now, for the bonus round:

Bonus: "The worst part of being human is never fully understanding the way someone else perceives the world." [...] "So, what have we learned today?" [...] "I just hope that, should we ever meet again, I'll get to hold your hand. I regret not doing that as much as I should have."
Himawari in "Flowerchild".



The reason this one is a bonus is because it's half narrated and can't be seen in replay. If looking with URM, input "beachwars18".
So, how did you do in this one? If this was your first quiz, make sure to search for previous rounds on the search bar through the "moonflare's quiz" query.

Moonflare's Quiz: "Who Said This?" #04

Time for the fourth round! This time it's a thematic one, with all the events coming from DORM WARS! Rules are the same as always: There are ten events, and you have to guess who said the following quotes, which could be from any character (excluding Akira).

To help guessing, most of them have more than one quote from each event (though one might be from the start and another from the end of the event). Guess who said it, check the answer, move to the next one (while keeping track of your overall score).
(mind that the same answer could happen more than once)

Who said this?

01: "Have any last words before your team is completely and utterly annihilated, Uta?" [...] "Yumi will absolutely participate because, if she doesn't, I have a complete log of her absences that I will be forwarding to the principal".
Makoto in "Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars!"

View attachment 4801652 View attachment 4801653
02: "Tell Ami to step down before she gets any further into her backstory or I'll basically lose before I even have a chance." [...] "Did you seriously get hard for your little sister? Pervert..."
Noriko in "Imouto Mode!"

View attachment 4801655 View attachment 4801656
03: "The idea of "fun" does not exist. All we have is silence....shadows...the dark...and a mission. A mission to remain unseen. Unheard. Unnoticed." [...] "Gone...like the color of the Chitose River in winter...waiting for its moment to return. But when? And who will be there to watch as the color returns?"
Uta in "Dorm War II: Pre-Game Show".

View attachment 4801657 View attachment 4801658
04: "Sorry, we're fresh out of 'You are extremely attractive and I was not prepared for that' on account of you being on a date." [...] "Not everything has an answer, you know! And not everything has to! So it's probably best to just never ask questions at all and accept everything you're given! And if it sounds like I'm saying that reluctantly, I'm not! Please! Just do what you're told!"
Himawari in "Hiding in Plain Sight".

View attachment 4801659 View attachment 4801660 View attachment 4801661
05: "Yes. I... I need help with English." [...] "Is she still looking over here? Should both of our tops magically fall off at the same time?" [...] "We have a problem. I can't remember which order I said things in. Do I take my top off or not?"
Rin in "Sexy Swimsuit Showdown".

View attachment 4801662 View attachment 4801665 View attachment 4801666
06: "The only difference now is you've somehow convinced everyone else you're nice." [...] "Do not talk about her to me or I actually will kill you." [...] "I have nothing to feel guilty about. I'm not the one who made him into what he is today."
Maya in "Flowerchild".

View attachment 4801667 View attachment 4801668 View attachment 4801669
07: "Touka, even though you've accidentally touched a horse wiener at least once, I've always loved you and am ready to spend the rest of my life with you." [...] "Touka, hurry the heck up! I ain't allowed to take my vitamins until you say your vows! Which, if ya think about it, doesn't make any sense for a friggin' 1v1 obstacle course!"
Miku in "Sea of Balls (Wise Turtle)".

View attachment 4801670 View attachment 4801671
08: "Hey, you don't have to be all shy and stuff! I think it'd be totally great if you lived here. I'm not trying to gate-keep it or anything. The more, the merrier." [...] "Plus, if you were looking at apartments, it would totally explain why you left the Dorm Wars early yesterday and forced us into an 8 v 10 match-up where we also lost a point due to your absence."
Chika in "Happy".

View attachment 4801672 View attachment 4801673
09: "Spiderwebs. A calendar. The ones you keep inside. A god. A bucket. Heresy. A man who almost died. A ghost. A moon. She's lying. There's nowhere we can hide. We're done. We're doomed. We're dying. The well has nearly dried."
Yasu in "Priestess of Fallen Snow".

View attachment 4801674 View attachment 4801675
10: "I don't want your fucking money." [...] "Christmas date!" [...] "If you're going to reject me again, at least do it properly. Don't just stand there like an idiot. Say something."
Niki in "Tip Your Bartender".

View attachment 4801676 View attachment 4801677 View attachment 4801678

Now, for the bonus round:

Bonus: "The worst part of being human is never fully understanding the way someone else perceives the world." [...] "So, what have we learned today?" [...] "I just hope that, should we ever meet again, I'll get to hold your hand. I regret not doing that as much as I should have."
Himawari in "Flowerchild".

Moonflare's Quiz: "Who Said This?" #04

Time for the fourth round! This time it's a thematic one, with all the events coming from DORM WARS! Rules are the same as always: There are ten events, and you have to guess who said the following quotes, which could be from any character (excluding Akira).

To help guessing, most of them have more than one quote from each event (though one might be from the start and another from the end of the event). Guess who said it, check the answer, move to the next one (while keeping track of your overall score).
(mind that the same answer could happen more than once)

Who said this?

01: "Have any last words before your team is completely and utterly annihilated, Uta?" [...] "Yumi will absolutely participate because, if she doesn't, I have a complete log of her absences that I will be forwarding to the principal".
Makoto in "Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars!"

View attachment 4801652 View attachment 4801653
02: "Tell Ami to step down before she gets any further into her backstory or I'll basically lose before I even have a chance." [...] "Did you seriously get hard for your little sister? Pervert..."
Noriko in "Imouto Mode!"

View attachment 4801655 View attachment 4801656
03: "The idea of "fun" does not exist. All we have is silence....shadows...the dark...and a mission. A mission to remain unseen. Unheard. Unnoticed." [...] "Gone...like the color of the Chitose River in winter...waiting for its moment to return. But when? And who will be there to watch as the color returns?"
Uta in "Dorm War II: Pre-Game Show".

View attachment 4801657 View attachment 4801658
04: "Sorry, we're fresh out of 'You are extremely attractive and I was not prepared for that' on account of you being on a date." [...] "Not everything has an answer, you know! And not everything has to! So it's probably best to just never ask questions at all and accept everything you're given! And if it sounds like I'm saying that reluctantly, I'm not! Please! Just do what you're told!"
Himawari in "Hiding in Plain Sight".

View attachment 4801659 View attachment 4801660 View attachment 4801661
05: "Yes. I... I need help with English." [...] "Is she still looking over here? Should both of our tops magically fall off at the same time?" [...] "We have a problem. I can't remember which order I said things in. Do I take my top off or not?"
Rin in "Sexy Swimsuit Showdown".

View attachment 4801662 View attachment 4801665 View attachment 4801666
06: "The only difference now is you've somehow convinced everyone else you're nice." [...] "Do not talk about her to me or I actually will kill you." [...] "I have nothing to feel guilty about. I'm not the one who made him into what he is today."
Maya in "Flowerchild".

View attachment 4801667 View attachment 4801668 View attachment 4801669
07: "Touka, even though you've accidentally touched a horse wiener at least once, I've always loved you and am ready to spend the rest of my life with you." [...] "Touka, hurry the heck up! I ain't allowed to take my vitamins until you say your vows! Which, if ya think about it, doesn't make any sense for a friggin' 1v1 obstacle course!"
Miku in "Sea of Balls (Wise Turtle)".

View attachment 4801670 View attachment 4801671

10: "I don't want your fucking money." [...] "Christmas date!" [...] "If you're going to reject me again, at least do it properly. Don't just stand there like an idiot. Say something."
Niki in "Tip Your Bartender".

Daniel140201 said:
hello, may i ask, like last time when i comments, my save sile got deleted, and i have download autoVN, guidemod and URM to get back my old save file. However, some of my status is showing like this. Does anyone know how to fix this ? View attachment 4803398
Click to expand...
The guess would be a improperly extracted AutoVN. I'd delete your extracted LiL folder, re-extract a new one and then just install AutoVN on its own again, trying to make sure the game folder merges properly with the game folder from the LiL install, then once you verify it has by going back to this screen and seeing that it isn't broken, do the same with the guide mod and URM.

Also seconding being cautious with URM. People get into the habit of using it to see all dialogue splits when most of it is stuff you're not meant to see, and not rolling back before the split so it isn't saved. They say something like "WTF I was watching a scene, a split appeared in the corner so I viewed it but didn't see any dialogue, and now I'm missing an event" when the split was checking if they made a choice that misses events, and they forced that to true.

Time for the fourth round! This time it's a thematic one, with all the events coming from DORM WARS! Rules are the same as always: There are ten events, and you have to guess who said the following quotes, which could be from any character (excluding Akira).

To help guessing, most of them have more than one quote from each event (though one might be from the start and another from the end of the event). Guess who said it, check the answer, move to the next one (while keeping track of your overall score).
(mind that the same answer could happen more than once)

Who said this?

01: "Have any last words before your team is completely and utterly annihilated, Uta?" [...] "Yumi will absolutely participate because, if she doesn't, I have a complete log of her absences that I will be forwarding to the principal".
Makoto in "Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars!"

View attachment 4801652 View attachment 4801653
02: "Tell Ami to step down before she gets any further into her backstory or I'll basically lose before I even have a chance." [...] "Did you seriously get hard for your little sister? Pervert..."
Noriko in "Imouto Mode!"

View attachment 4801655 View attachment 4801656
03: "The idea of "fun" does not exist. All we have is silence....shadows...the dark...and a mission. A mission to remain unseen. Unheard. Unnoticed." [...] "Gone...like the color of the Chitose River in winter...waiting for its moment to return. But when? And who will be there to watch as the color returns?"
Uta in "Dorm War II: Pre-Game Show".

View attachment 4801657 View attachment 4801658
04: "Sorry, we're fresh out of 'You are extremely attractive and I was not prepared for that' on account of you being on a date." [...] "Not everything has an answer, you know! Himawari in "Hiding in Plain Sight".

Rin in "Sexy Swimsuit Showdown".

Maya in "Flowerchild".

Miku in "Sea of Balls (Wise Turtle)".

Fire Lord Zuko said:
How to trigger the "Alexisthymia" Happy Event:
1.) Complete the entire 0.44 and 0.45 Halloween event chain.

2.) Download the URM or borrow someone else's save file that starts at the beginning of the "Amy" Happy Event. You cannot use the replay feature to trigger the new Happy Event. It will not work. If you're borrowing a save and not using URM, skip to step 4B.

3.) (URM only) Open up your URM menu with alt+M. By default, it will say Search in Variable Names. You don't want this. Click where it says 'Variable Names' and change it to where it says 'Labels/Scenes'.

4A.) (URM only) With that set, type 'alexisevent' in the search bar. Click 'Jump' to jump straight to the new Happy Event.

4B.) If you borrowed someone else's save, upon starting the "Amy" happy event and making it to the first choice menu, move left and then forward to reach the Taco Bell in the mall. This will trigger the Happy Event for you.

5.) When you have reached the end, you'll know it when Amy wants to get back to your date. When she finishes talking, ignore this and reload back to your latest save at the end of 0.45. 0.49 Event Triggers:

posts.content_html_raw:
Two trivial things that I am kinda surprised in v0.49
First is Maya's sexuality. Back in the days when Noriko said "there is at least one bisexual in every dorm except dorm2, 3, and 9" according to her survey, I was super sure that Ami instead of Maya would be the bi in dorm5 because, Maya really has not shown any interest in any other human being other than Sensei and there is no way that Maya wouldn't just tell Noriko to fuck off when she conducted her survey. Thus, to have Noriko reach that conclusion, Noriko either must have received a positive reply "yes I also like girls" from Ami, or she must have known Maya was a bi since they were rival wizards; this whole time I lean toward the former since the latter wasn't as likely.

Alas, recent events have leaned hard toward "Ami straight, Maya gay" direction, and the most recent swimsuit showdown finally tips my balance over; it's one thing to admire someone's figure (want to be just like her) and it's another thing to want to put your hands on the said figure (want her).


If Ami Prime wasn't lying about being straight, and the Ami back then did tell Noriko that she's straight, then I suppose the surprise I am experiencing is either Maya was willing to tell Noriko that she was bi, or Noriko simply knew this since they were wizards and her statement "there is at least one bi in dorm5" wasn't dependent on Ami's answer at all.

Ayane is older than Ami. This perhaps is the most surprising trivia for me.
Ayane is 9/25 and Ami is 8/31; it would be absolutely fine if the semester starts in early September unlike how it is done there in Japan; but I digress.

The reason I was surprised is because some of the seemingly contradicting info from care packages.


There, you can see that Ayane is 15 while Noriko is 16. From this, some of the conclusions I reach and assumptions I make are:
- These character information documents are all made between 7/28 and 9/25 to account for the 15 vs 16. Ayane is close to being 16 but not yet 16 while Noriko has just reached 16.
- Their "birth moments" were roughly two months apart; meaning, there is no bumped up/held back involved like Rin/Chika. Both their admissions are with regular cohorts.
- Time loops, time travels, and time-based shenanigans have no weight in the matter because a) technically this older/younger trend is something already established prior to even the first cycle began, and b) there is no mention in the game that talked about being inside an infinite loop alters relative age differences.
- No mistake was made by Sel.


This is where things get weird for me when it comes to placing the “start date of the first/Fall semester that kicks off a school year” to properly account for all the older/younger information in hand surrounding Ayane, Ami, and Noriko.
- To have Ayane being older than Ami, start date will have to be between 8/31-9/25, as aforementioned.
- To have Noriko being older than Ayane, start date will have to be either earlier than 7/28 or later than 9/25.
- Second bullet point is already falling part; both options contradict the first bullet point, and “later than 9/25” option further violates the canon fact “Ayane (9/25) is older than Sana (1/4)”, something established in The Sakakibara Diet.
- Things get even muddier if one further factors in other information in **, namely the ages and birthdays of Karin and Chika. I left these two out because I already couldn’t figure out what to do when there are only three girls on the table.

So yeah, I don’t know. One or more of my assumptions must be wrong, or some of the information is not correctly interpreted; but I’d try to find any blind spot of mine before giving in to “Selly probably didn’t think this through”.

posts.content_html_raw:
So just finished the update. It was ok. The yearly ones are kinda gatekeeping releases to keep you from getting too far ahead with any group of girls so I dont expect a lot of great stories from it, but more setups for future ones.

Things I loved
Homies Back
Honestly both dates were good
The Courtroom
Noriko ignoring her cooking to help Yumi
D&D being Shrek+ Rin and Chika's interaction
Touka vs Ami??
Otoha+Futuba
Noriko+Yumi
Rin being more confident in herself although it seems to hit Chika where it hurts. Interested to see where that goes
Was Nodako trying to overload the sex/debauchery to such a high level to break the cycle?

Things I didn't like
Miku is just too 1 trick now
The comedy show was a bit of a lt down
Oh god Sana what happened to you?
Sara
Not sure how everybody knowing about everybody is going to work. Will be weird most of them just going along with it

Overall maybe a 5 or 6 out of10.

Girls I liked more from this: Rin, Noriko, Ayane, Otoha, Sara

Girls who dropped: Miku, Sana, Ami, Osako

posts.content_html_raw:
I think in the future the only way this update doesn't stick out as a low quality update is if the direction of the story leans harder into the supernatural. Nodoka jokingly refers to the relative lack of progress in chapter 4 so far, and that she was moving to correct that. Part of what makes the end of this update miss the mark for me is the lack of time spent witnessing the characters react to it; a lot of how or what character's feel or think about it seem to be left off screen or inbetween the lines, when the significance/trauma of the events almost require more time to adequately react to in order to maintain a semblance of believability. As things stand, this update more than any other shatters my suspension of disbelief, but that's more so because of what's not in it, rather than what is.

With this story, Sel has done a great job depicting and exploring trauma, it's causes, effects, and horror, in a very full way that doesn't seem superficial, so far. The events of this update remind me a lot of the manga/anime Heavenly Delusion; extreme, identity questioning/shattering trauma is inflicted on important characters, and little to no time was spent really exploring the consequences/ensuing struggle resulting from trauma. If anyone recalls this post I made, then they might have this in the back of their mind somewhere.

Something is wrong in Kumon-mi right now. Even moreso than usual. And it all started in update 0.42 (the latest Beach Trip), particularly the ending of “Perfect Harmony”.

Akira was warned not to go outside, but he did anyway. When that failed, we saw Himawari show up and interact with Ayane directly. She had some kind of plan. But what? We still don’t know.

Anyway, then weird shit happened and things have been weird ever since. Everything is more… out in the open, so to speak. We’re warned multiple times afterward that “things are off”.

Not to mention the Beach is currently closed off due to a ‘tidal disaster’. Preeeetty weird.

It’s my belief that we’ll get some answers during the next Beach Trip update, as the narrator hinted at at the end of the last Reset. Sooo, update 0.52.

Maybe I’m wrong, but hey, I’m willing to stick to this belief for now if only to… lessen the sour taste that was Sana’s actions this update.

- About the Nodoka discussion… I can see what both sides of the argument are saying, but really, it’s a complicated situation. My belief is this:

I hate she did to Yumi. It was self serving and was used as a means for revenge. Revenge that Futaba, the one Nodoka was doing this for, didn’t consent to. Nodoka even admits she went overboard in this very update when questioned about it.

As for the other stuff? The stuff that revolves around breaking everyone out of their prison? Knowing her intentions, while seeing other characters hurt doesn’t make me feel good… I can understand.

It’s for the greater good. Sometimes the correct choice isn’t the most popular one, but damn y’all, someone has to do it.

Some people look at Nodoka through too broad a lense. Their perspective makes things out to be so black and white, but in reality, it’s not that simple at all.

The fact is, yes, Nodoka does things that hurt people. But only for the short term. In her mind, once she cracks the code and frees everyone? Once the truth is revealed? The ones she saved will be understanding too.

Nodoka really is all alone, or at least, she thinks she is. She’s just a teenager. A genius, yes, but a teenager nonetheless.

Once someone *cough* Akira *cough* grows the balls to finally tell her about the existence of the RAS and how others are aware of the time loops too, well then… things might become interesting.

- On a more lighthearted note, the dates with Rin and Io were really well done. Both got a kiss out of it too, so, hell yeah.

Wonder what’s up with that bottomless pit, though… Or that supposed door with a keypad for that matter. Y’know, the destination Io was planning on taking Akira to begin with?

Sounds suspicious, no? And I’m surprised no one else has talked about it. What the hell is a keypad door doing inside a cave? More and more questions to unpack…

- I’m quite looking forward to Maya’s events next update. It’s high time this version of Maya gets some genuine development. Her and Akira have been tiptoeing around each other for wayyyy too long.

- Also, goddamit Ami! Stop abusing Maya! You make it so hard to like you, but I still do for whatever fucking reason. (She’s interesting, okay?)

- More voices in Yumi’s head… I can only assume this will snowball into the wildest sex ever seen in this game when the time comes. We can’t be blueballed forever… right?

- Oh yeah. Nodokathon 2 as a whole. I didn’t like it. The footjobs were fine. I’m not a foot fetishist, but I really don’t see the problem with them. Plus I’m surprised it’s never happened in the game before.

Ami and Ayane’s threesome with Akira. Strangely hot, although I feel bad for Ayane… She seemed to get into it, though, but… who knows how much of that can be attributed to her acting skills?

Sana and Molly’s thing. Blegh. I’ve already said enough about it. I’ll be waiting for Sara’s events in 0.50. One can only imagine what fresh hell we’ll be in for. Especially since Sel said this in his AMA about Sara (it’s towards the bottom):


For the record, I disagree, Sel. Yumi is amazing and I will die on this hill.

- The Dorm Wars contests as a whole? Decent. Certainly far better than Sports Wars. Less Good Kid too! Although I don’t mind their music overall, it doesn’t fit when reading a VN.

- Yasu looked cute this update. This needed addressing.

- That is all.

As for the other stuff? The stuff that revolves around breaking everyone out of their prison? Knowing her intentions, while seeing other characters hurt doesn’t make me feel
good
… I can understand.
It’s for the greater good. Sometimes the correct choice isn’t the most popular one, but damn y’all, someone has to do it.
Some people look at Nodoka through too broad a lense. Their perspective makes things out to be so black and white, but in reality, it’s not that simple at all.
The fact is, yes, Nodoka does things that hurt people. But only for the short term. In her mind, once she cracks the code and frees everyone? Once the truth is revealed? The ones she saved will be understanding too.
Nodoka really is all alone, or at least, she thinks she is. She’s just a teenager. A genius, yes, but a teenager nonetheless.
Once someone
*cough*
Akira
*cough*
grows the balls to finally tell her about the existence of the RAS and how others are aware of the time loops too, well then… things might become interesting.

Wonder what’s up with that bottomless pit, though… Or that supposed door with a
keypad
for that matter. Y’know, the destination Io was planning on taking Akira to begin with?
Sounds suspicious, no? And I’m surprised no one else has talked about it. What the hell is a keypad door doing inside a cave? More and more questions to unpack…
- I’m quite looking forward to Maya’s events next update. It’s high time this version of Maya gets some genuine development. Her and Akira have been tiptoeing around each other for wayyyy too long.

Ami and Ayane’s threesome with Akira. Strangely hot, although I feel bad for Ayane… She seemed to get into it, though, but… who knows how much of that can be attributed to her acting skills?
Sana and Molly’s thing. Blegh. I’ve already said enough about it. I’ll be waiting for Sara’s events in 0.50. One can only imagine what fresh hell we’ll be in for. Especially since Sel said this in his AMA about Sara (it’s towards the bottom):
Spoiler

contests
as a whole? Decent. Certainly far better than Sports Wars. Less Good Kid too! Although I don’t mind their music overall, it doesn’t fit when reading a VN.

- That is all.

spoilers.html:
- Okay, so first of all, I’m going to address the elephant in the room: what the hell is wrong with you, Sana??

Like, dude, that’s your mother. She’s the only family you have left and she loves you more than anything!

There are so many who would envy your position, and Molly points this out too in the aftermath. No, Molly isn’t totally innocent in this either, but at the same time: Haruka isn’t her family, is a predator, and is a fully functioning adult who is well aware of what she was doing.

Sara, though? Asked by her own daughter to sleep with the man she loves to raise her grades? All while Sana knew where it was leading?

That’s really fucked up.

Also, Sana’s cool with incest now? Tf?

But y’know… This makes for an interesting segue into my next point.
